name: The Clockwork Dragon Guarding a Sunlit Library
description: A gentle, intricate clockwork dragon made of brass and gears curled protectively around a ancient, sun-drenched stone library overgrown with ivy.
prompt: A majestic yet gentle clockwork dragon made of polished brass, copper gears, and intricate mechanical parts, curled around an ancient stone library building. The library is overgrown with green ivy, and warm, golden sunlight streams through the tall windows and archways. The dragon's eyes glow with a soft, warm light, guarding the sanctuary of knowledge. Steampunk, fantasy, highly detailed.
caption: The mechanical guardian of ancient wisdom, basking in the warm, golden light of timeless stories. 📚🐉
